data.action: 足尖点梁翻转腾挪，蝶翼羽织展开，毒针寒光，落地眨眼
data.camera: dynamic action shot, mid-air twist, haori spread, venom flash
data.description: 【黄昏的天守遗迹·鬼气弥漫】紫蝶般的身影在残垣间翻转腾挪，蝶翼羽织在身后展开如真正的蝶翅。忍足尖轻点断梁，毒针在指间寒光一闪，脸上却始终挂着那抹温柔的笑——「虫之呼吸 · 蜈蚣之腹。」轻如蝶落，毒已入髓。她落地收刃，对呆住的你眨了眨眼——「看呆了呢。要跟上哦，下一个敌人可不会等你。」
data.lighting: 橙紫渐变的黄昏天光与蝶翼羽织的紫纹
data.promptProse: Kochou Shinobu flips and vaults across the broken beams of a demon-haunted fortress ruin at dusk, her butterfly-patterned haori spreading behind her like real wings. Her toes graze a splintered rafter, the hidden stinger flashes cold light between her fingers, and her gentle smile never wavers as she names Insect Breathing, Centipede. Landing softly with her gradient black-purple hair settling, she winks at your stunned face and reminds you the next enemy will not wait. Dynamic action shot, cinematic lighting, detailed ruin background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 虫之呼吸的蝶舞·「虫之呼吸 · 蜈蚣之腹 ひらり」
